name: My Gym Mommy Treats Me Like A Kid
source:
You play as Daisuke Sato, an average salary-man who gets offered the chance of a lifetime : a membership at the highly exclusive, ultra posh Silver's Gym!

But things take a dark turn when you are laughed at and humiliated by the other members, tall muscular girls who look down on weak men like you.

In your time of need, however, you meet with Minami Nakayama, a soft-spoken and motherly mature woman with the body of a yoga instructor. She will ease your pain and soothe your soul, but what are her true intentions?

How far are you willing to go to please Minami? Will you end up giving in to your vulnerable side and finally call her...Mommy?

[From [url=https://peachpunchgames.itch.io/gym-mommy]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演普通上班族佐藤大辅，有机会获得梦寐以求的福利：加入门槛极高、奢华无比的Silver健身房！

然而，其他会员——一群身材高挑健壮的女孩——看不起你这样软弱的男人，还对你嘲笑羞辱，事情逐渐变得黑暗。

在你最需要帮助的时候，你遇见了说话轻声细语、成熟而有母性光辉的中山南。她拥有瑜伽教练般的身材，会抚慰你的伤痛、安抚你的心灵；但她真正的意图是什么？

为了取悦南，你愿意做到什么地步？你会屈服于自己脆弱的一面，终于开口叫她一声……妈妈吗？[引自[url=https://peachpunchgames.itch.io/gym-mommy]Itch.io[/url]]
